query: bus pass refund
description: Bus pass cancellation refund tiers: 90% before classes, 50% within first 15 days, zero after 15 days (except medical/withdrawal); credited to bank in 14 working days.

query: mess diet change
description: Diet (veg/non-veg/Jain) changes via DormTrack Diet Switcher, submitted before the 25th of the preceding month.

query: library fine rates
description: Overdue fines Rs 5/day/book for days 1-7, Rs 10/day/book from day 8; account locked if unpaid fines exceed Rs 50.

query: EC department electives
description: No document lists EC/ECE electives; ECE-CRS-001 gives only the core course roadmap (ECE201/204/302/305/402), no elective list.

query: vehicle parking sticker
description: Register vehicle on CampusPass with RC/insurance/licence; Security affixes RFID windshield/fork tag within 3 working days.

query: phd thesis regulations
description: PhD thesis: after progress reviews, publications and plagiarism check, pre-synopsis colloquium, two external evaluators, viva voce; max N+2 (6 yrs); similarity <=10%.

query: industry advisory board members
description: Each department's IAB has 5-7 senior industry leaders (Engineering Directors, CTOs, Enterprise Architects) on two-year tenure.

query: exam malpractice penalty
description: Malpractice Levels 1-3: L1 paper cancelled/F; L2 all semester exams cancelled, F in all courses; L3 result cancelled, 1-2 yr debarment or expulsion.

query: MFA account reset
description: Account reset via SSPR with OTP to registered phone/email, in person at IAM Desk (Turing Complex) with RFID ID, or remote ResolveDesk ticket with govt photo ID.

query: dream company offers
description: Dream companies offer CTC > Rs 12 LPA; students with one Regular (<= 8 LPA) offer may still sit for them; a Dream offer freezes placement status.

query: how many books can i borrow from the library at once
description: UG may borrow 4 books for 14 days; PG/PhD 6 books for 28 days; faculty 10 for 90 days.

query: what happens if i get caught with my phone during the end sem exam
description: Mere possession of a phone is Level-2 malpractice: device and booklet seized, all semester exams cancelled (F grades), referral to Proctorial Board.

query: can i keep an electric kettle in my hostel room
description: High-wattage heating/cooking appliances (immersion rods, heating coils, cooking stoves, hotplates) are banned; only low-power devices permitted; violators fined Rs 2,500/5,000. Kettle not named explicitly.

query: who do i contact if the fan in my classroom isn't working
description: Log a ResolveDesk ticket under Campus Operations (Electrical Infrastructure covers ceiling fans).

query: how do i get a letter from college showing total fees for my education loan
description: Apply via UniCampus ERP > Student Services > Education Loan Fee Estimation Request with bank details/sanction letter; issued in 4 working days, collect at Registrar counter.

query: what should i do if the fire alarm goes off in my building
description: Stop work, leave belongings, no lifts, use fire stairs, move orderly to designated assembly point; no re-entry until All-Clear.

query: who is above the section officer in the admin office
description: Admin hierarchy: Registrar > Deputy Registrar (Administration) > Office Superintendent > counter staff. No Section Officer role exists; closest is Office Superintendent.

query: what approvals do we need to take our class on an industrial visit
description: Coordinator submits itinerary, risk assessment, transport requisition on ResolveDesk 15 working days ahead; parental consent forms; 1 faculty per 20 students.

query: how do i access ieee papers from home
description: Off campus, log in through the LibNet Off-Campus E-Journal Proxy Gateway with UniCampus ERP SSO credentials.

query: where can i talk to a counselor if i'm feeling stressed
description: Student Counseling & Mental Wellness Centre (Office of Student Welfare, Chanakya Bhavan 3rd floor): free confidential sessions via ResolveDesk Wellness Appointment or walk-in Mon-Fri 9-5.

query: TC appl form
description: After full No-Dues clearance, submit UniCampus ERP > Student Services > TC & Migration Request; certificates ready in 7 working days.

query: phd progress rpt guidelines
description: Semi-annual PR reviews (Jun-Jul, Dec-Jan); supervisor submits dossier on ResTrack 10 days before DC meeting; Satisfactory rating needed for fellowship, two Unsatisfactory may terminate registration.

query: CR election rules
description: CR elections coordinated by Program Coordinator in first two weeks; one CR + deputy per section, one-year term; candidates need CGPA >= 7.0, no backlogs, clean record.

query: OD leave appl form
description: Submit OD form on ResolveDesk (Student Affairs > On-Duty Sanction) 3 working days before, with brochure/schedule/faculty endorsement; max 10 days/semester; upload certificate within 5 days after.

query: acad council standing committee powers
description: Academic Council enacts regulations, approves programs/syllabi, sets grading/passing criteria and appoints its Standing Committee (Senate Academic Committee) to adjudicate extraordinary academic appeals.

query: intl students FRRO reg
description: Foreign students must register on the e-FRRO portal within 14 days of arrival; International Student Advisor submits Form S; hostel issues residential bonafide as address proof.

query: TA/DA reimb for official travel
description: TA/DA entitlements (sleeper/3AC rail or bus fare, per diem DA, registration fee) need pre-travel sanction; claims filed on ResolveDesk Finance > TA/DA Claims within 15 working days with tickets, invoices, certificates; NEFT within 10 days of audit.

query: CC lab hrs and machine allotment
description: Central Computing Centre open Mon-Fri 8AM-10PM, Sat 9AM-6PM, closed Sunday, 24h around SEE; machines first-come-first-served via RFID/SSO, clubs can reserve blocks via ResolveDesk 5 days ahead.

query: dup ID card req
description: Log Security > Lost ID Card on ResolveDesk, pay Rs 500 via PayVarsity, show receipt + govt photo ID at Central Security Office; duplicate card issued within 48 hours.

query: no dues cert for final yr
description: No-dues clearance via UniCampus ERP in the May-June graduation window with sign-offs from Library, Hostel, Department labs, Ops/Sports and Finance (5-day SLA); then caution deposit refund and certificate release.

query: migraton certificate
description: After no-dues clearance, file TC & Migration Request on UniCampus ERP (STU-FRM-003); Registrar signs/seals within 7 working days, collected or speed-posted; duplicates need police report + affidavit + Rs 1000.

query: intellectual proprety patent filing
description: Patent filing: Invention Disclosure Form on ResTrack, IPR Committee evaluation, university funds 100% of filing costs, royalties 60/40 inventor/university; ownership depends on funding source.

query: medical condonaton form
description: Medical condonation form (STU-FRM-005) for 65-74.9% attendance: clinical proofs plus Health Centre Verification Slip, FA/HOD endorsement, lodged on ResolveDesk 5 working days before SEE; Dean approval lifts detention.

query: suplementary exam fee deadline
description: Supplementary registration closes 5 PM on the 10th calendar day after results; 3-day late window with Rs 500 fine; fee Rs 600 per paper via PayVarsity.

query: scholorship for sports players
description: Sports Excellence Scholarship: 25-100% tuition concession for athletes representing the university, endorsed by Director of PE and DSA; Joint Scholarship Committee selection; must keep CGPA 6.50 and team participation.

query: hostle curfew timings
description: Hostel curfew 9:30 PM weekdays, 10:30 PM weekends, roll call 10 PM; three unexcused curfew violations cancel residency.

query: incubaton seed grant
description: CIE micro-seed grants for pre-incubation prototype teams cover components, materials, cloud hosting; proposals via ResTrack, evaluated by CIE Pitch Evaluation Committee, audited by Finance.

query: proctorial board disiplinary hearing
description: Proctorial Board hearing: show-cause within 48h, inquiry done in 7 working days, in camera hearing with right to see evidence and defend, no outside lawyers; sanctions admonition to expulsion ratified by Registrar.

query: resume uplod careerhub
description: Upload resume on CareerHub as PDF max 2MB following CDC template; without a verified master resume students cannot register for drives.

query: librery reading room 24 hours
description: Ground Floor 24/7 Reading Room open round the clock; entry 10PM-6AM by RFID via CampusPass only; hostelers must log night study on DormTrack.

query: CSE201 lab exercises
description: CSE201 lab: six experiments (linked lists, dual-stack evaluator, circular queue, AVL tree, Dijkstra, hash table) in Turing Complex Data Systems Lab.

query: CSE303 sql lab manual
description: CSE303 query lab on PostgreSQL: ER mapping, constraints, complex SQL joins/subqueries, PL/pgSQL procedures/triggers, transaction isolation.

query: CSE401 ml course outline
description: CSE401 AIML outline: 4 credits; modules on search, supervised learning, SVM/ensembles, unsupervised/PCA, neural networks; labs; 40/60 CIE/SEE.

query: ECE201 logic design lab
description: ECE201 Digital Electronics Hardware Lab (Faraday Tower 2F): NAND/NOR gates, 4-bit adder IC7483, 8:1 mux IC74151, JK up/down counter, Verilog Mealy/Moore detectors.

query: ECE302 vlsi EDA tools
description: ECE302 EDA lab uses Cadence EDA tools and SPICE via EDA Cloud Lab in the VLSI Design Centre; labs: inverter VTC, transient, layout, DRC/LVS, 6T SRAM.

query: MEC204 heat transfer experiments
description: MEC204 Thermal Engineering Lab: thermal conductivity of insulating powder, natural/forced convection, pin-fin, Stefan-Boltzmann, parallel/counter-flow heat exchanger.

query: CIV205 structural analysis software
description: CIV205 computational practicum at Aryabhata Wing Computational Station: computer-aided beam deflection, frame sway, matrix stiffness software modeling of RC structures (no specific software product named).

query: CSE202 java coding standards
description: ACAD-CRS-002 (CSE202 Java) has objectives, syllabus, labs and assessment but no Java coding standards/style rules despite its title; nothing else in the corpus covers coding standards.

query: CSE305 agile project deliverables
description: CSE305 capstone: teams of 4, three 4-week sprints; Sprint 1 backlog/SRS/architecture, Sprint 2 prototype/unit tests/CI-CD, Sprint 3 deployable product, code audits, defense.

query: CIV310 BOD COD lab manual
description: Environmental Engineering lab manual (CIV-LAB-304, course CIV304 not CIV310): 5-day 20C BOD Winkler procedure and formula; COD named in scope but no COD procedure given.

query: 75% attendance requirement
description: Minimum 75.0% attendance required in every registered course; 65-74.9% condonable on medical/OD grounds; below 65% means detention from SEE.

query: late fee after 15 days of registration
description: Late registration after DOR (Aug 5): Rs 100/day Aug 6-15; after Aug 15 Rs 250/day (Aug 16-Sep 4) with HOD endorsement; registration closes permanently Sep 5.

query: can i register for 28 credits
description: Normal load is 20-24 credits; overload up to 28 credits only with CGPA >= 8.00 and no backlogs (with advisor/HOD/Dean approval).

query: minimum 5.0 CGPA to graduate
description: UG degree requires minimum terminal CGPA 5.00 on 10-point scale (PG requires 6.00), plus 160 credits and zero backlogs.

query: Rs 500 challan for duplicate marksheet
description: No duplicate marksheet/grade-card fee exists in the corpus; the Rs 500 E-Challan fee in FIN-POL-002 is for a duplicate RFID ID card, and the only duplicate-certificate fee is Rs 1,000 for a TC/migration certificate.

query: tuition fee penalty after 30 days
description: Unpaid tuition beyond 30 days from billing triggers a FINANCIAL-HOLD (blocks registration, hall ticket, documents); late surcharges are Rs 100/day (days 16-25) and Rs 250/day (days 26-45).

query: CIE marks out of 50
description: CIE carries 40% weightage (50% only where regulations mandate equal split); CIE1/CIE2 sessional tests are 90 min scaled to 50 marks; 40% CIE minimum needed for SEE.

query: 2 night outs per month hostel
description: No monthly night-out quota (e.g., 2 per month) exists in the corpus; hostel docs (HSTL-POL-001, POL-HOSTEL-LEAVE) only describe the night-out pass procedure (24h advance + parental OTP + warden approval) without any numeric limit.

query: 6 month internship in 8th semester
description: Semester-long 8th-semester industry internship allowed with CGPA >= 7.00, zero backlogs, verified offer and NOC; substitutes 8th-sem electives with an industry capstone project.

query: companies offering above 10 LPA CTC tier
description: CTC tiers: Regular tier up to Rs 8 LPA; Dream tier strictly above Rs 12 LPA (priority slots, open to Regular-offer holders). No tier is defined at 10 LPA.

query: what is the policy on one offer per student in placements
description: One-Student-One-Job: a Regular tier offer (<= 8 LPA) locks out further Regular drives; student may still try Dream (> 12 LPA) drives; a Dream offer freezes placement status.

query: policy on air conditioner usage in labs and offices
description: Thermostats in offices/halls kept at 24-26 C, never below 22 C, doors/windows closed; central HVAC runs 08:30-17:30 on lecture days; 24/7 only for server rooms/HPC/library hub.

query: rules about silence hours in hostel
description: Hostel silence hours are 11:00 PM to 6:00 AM daily; loud music, speakers, shouting and rowdy gatherings are prohibited.

query: policy if i break lab equipment
description: Report breakage immediately; TA logs incident; accidental damage during proper use is absorbed by university, negligent damage is charged to PayVarsity/caution deposit, vandalism is a Level-3 offense.

query: what is the rule on staying in a pg outside campus
description: First-years must live on campus (except local day scholars); 2nd-year+ UG, PG and PhD may move to an off-campus PG with a parental consent affidavit on ERP; safety advisories apply.

query: university policy on students talking to the media
description: Only VC, Registrar or PRO may speak for the university; students are prohibited from making statements to media on its behalf without written authorization from the Director of Media Relations.

query: policy on uploading thesis to institutional repository
description: IR deposit is mandatory for theses; similarity <= 10% via Turnitin; upload PDF/A with metadata and Turnitin certificate through LibNet; open access with a 6-12 month embargo option.

query: acceptable use policy for university email and computers
description: Accounts are personal (no password/MFA sharing); prohibited: scanning, torrents/piracy, crypto mining, malware; violations lead to account revocation and Proctorial Board referral.

query: dress code rules for placement interviews
description: Formal attire required (suit or formal shirt, trousers, leather shoes, tie, or formal Indian attire); jeans, t-shirts, sports shoes, sandals prohibited; ID card must be displayed.

query: rules for starting a new student club
description: A new club needs at least 20 active student members and written sponsorship of a full-time faculty mentor; charter renewed annually in August via ClubSpace.

query: who is eligible for paying fees in installments
description: Installments open to UG/PG students with documented hardship, family medical emergency or pending loan, in good academic standing, with no prior fee arrears; needs CFO approval.

query: can i get need based financial aid
description: Merit-cum-Means Hardship Aid gives 25-50% tuition concession for capable students with certified family income below Rs 4,50,000; renewal requires CGPA >= 8.00, no backlogs, clean record.

query: who can apply for dual degree abroad
description: Exchange/dual degree open to UG students who completed four semesters with CGPA >= 7.50 and zero active backlogs; apply via ERP with SOP and language scores.

query: am i eligible for the fast track summer term exam
description: Summer term is only for students with an F grade or attendance detention (W/SA, below 65%); maximum two backlog courses; fees paid on PayVarsity.

query: who can become a resident assistant in hostel
description: RA eligibility: CGPA >= 7.50, zero backlogs, at least one year of on-campus residency with clean conduct record; selected each July via Chief Warden interviews.

query: eligibility for research assistant fellowship
description: RA candidates need relevant UG/PG engineering/science degree with GATE/NET qualification or demonstrated academic excellence; selected by PI-chaired committee.

query: can first year students get a hostel room
description: Yes: first-year outstation UG students get priority allotment (Cauvery for men, Sarojini for women); first-years must live on campus unless local day scholars.

query: do i qualify for OD if i attend a hackathon
description: OD can be sanctioned for national/international technical hackathons endorsed by HOD/DSA (not private commercial hackathons); max 10 days per semester.

query: can day scholars use the college bus service
description: Yes: the university bus fleet serves enrolled day-scholar students; enroll via TransPass and pay zonal fee on PayVarsity.

query: can staff carry forward unused casual leave
description: HR-POL-003 only states 12 days CL per year; no rule on carrying forward unused casual leave exists anywhere in corpus.

query: how do i escalate a resolvedesk ticket that's not resolved
description: If a ticket breaches SLA or outcome is unsatisfactory, click 'Escalate' within 48 hours to route it to the next governance tier (Level 2 committee, then Ombudsman).

query: steps to file a complaint online as a student
description: Log in to ResolveDesk with SSO, choose 'Submit New Grievance' and category, fill docket, attach evidence (PDF/PNG/JPEG <=10MB), submit to get GRV tracking code; 5-day SLA.

query: how do i vacate my hostel room at end of year
description: Submit Room Vacation Notice on DormTrack 7 working days ahead, joint inventory inspection with caretaker, damages billed, surrender keys (Rs.1000 if unreturned); warden sign-off clears hostel no-dues.

query: how to submit assignment on learnsphere
description: Upload to the course assignment dropbox on LearnSphere (learn.demo.edu.internal) in PDF/DOCX/ZIP before deadline; 25 MB per file limit; failures go to ResolveDesk 'LMS Technical Support'.

query: steps to report a theft on campus
description: File a Security Incident Report on ResolveDesk (Campus Security > Incident Report) or report in person at the 24/7 Security Operations Centre at Main Gate; theft tiered by severity.

query: how do i pay fees through net banking on payvarsity
description: Log in to PayVarsity (pay.demo.edu.internal) via SSO, review demand, choose Net Banking, authorize on bank page, ledger syncs and download signed receipt.

query: how to view my answer script after results
description: Within 7 days of results, apply on ExamShield > Examination Services > Answer Script Viewing, pay Rs.400/paper on PayVarsity; scanned PDF uploaded within 5 working days.

query: how to request repair of leaking tap in hostel room
description: Log a request on ResolveDesk 'Hostel Maintenance' portal or submit a work order at the Caretaker Desk; leaking taps fall under Plumbing & Water Supply.

query: how to check grades on the erp portal
description: ERP guide (IT-SYS-001) lists enrollment, fee ledger, bonafide, degree audit modules but nothing on viewing grades/results; results are only incidentally said to be published on ExamShield.

query: process to get my medical certificate verified at health centre
description: Within 3 working days of resuming classes, present original hospital records in person at the Medical Verification Desk; Senior CMO audits and issues a Medical Verification Slip, which is uploaded to ResolveDesk.

query: my name is on the debarred list, can't write exams
description: Students failing fees/attendance/CIE criteria are placed on the ExamShield detention roster and debarred; clear dues or get condonation forwarded 5 days before SEE; appeals to Dean of Academic Affairs within 3 days.

query: dropping out of college and getting my documents back
description: After withdrawal request and full No-Dues clearance, apply on ERP for TC & Migration (reason: Personal Withdrawal); certificates issued within 7 working days for collection or speed post.

query: fingerprint scanner not marking my attendance
description: Log an 'Attendance Biometric Glitch' ticket on ResolveDesk within 48 hours with course/date/slot/room; IT audits logs, instructor verifies, HOD/Dean authorize AttendEdge patch.

query: seniors bullying freshers where to complain
description: Report ragging 24x7 via Anti-Ragging hotline, anonymous ResolveDesk module, or directly to wardens, security, or Dean of Student Welfare.

query: letter saying i'm currently enrolled for visa application
description: Request a bonafide/proof-of-study (Visa/Embassy attestation category, 4-day SLA) via UniCampus ERP > Student Services > Certificates; embossing at Chanakya Bhavan counter if needed.

query: who has the final say in running the university
description: The Executive Council, chaired by the Vice-Chancellor, is the apex executive and governing authority (budgets, statutes, appointments, final appeals).

query: aptitude prep classes before placement season
description: CDC/CPTD pre-placement training in semesters 5-7 includes Quantitative Aptitude & Logical Reasoning, coding, and soft skills modules; 85% attendance required for placement eligibility.

query: getting my money back if i quit the program
description: Tuition refund tiers by withdrawal timing: 100% minus Rs.1000 (>=15 days before classes), 90%, 80%, 50%, 0% after 30 days; caution deposit fully refundable; NEFT within 14 working days.

query: how often are departments audited for quality
description: IQAC conducts annual Department Operational Reviews; peer audit teams inspect departments every June and report to the Vice-Chancellor.

query: websites blocked on campus internet
description: The perimeter gateway blocks malicious, phishing, gambling, P2P torrent and explicit sites; academic exceptions via ResolveDesk 'Firewall Whitelisting Exception' ticket.
